sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can give advice by imagining myself in someone's place, with a helyedben and ha ... lennék.
I can soften advice with -hat/-het + conditional and jobb lenne, ha.
I can weigh two options with egyrészt/másrészt and inkább... mint...
I can warn someone caringly with nehogy and -hat/-het, and talk about persuading and encouraging.
